FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_Fibonacci_Calculator
VAR_INPUT
    N : DINT := 5; // Input value for the Fibonacci sequence term
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    O : DINT := 1; // Output value for the N-th Fibonacci number
END_VAR
VAR
    F1 : DINT := 1; // First Fibonacci number
    F2 : DINT := 1; // Second Fibonacci number
    CNT : DINT := 2; // Counter for the loop
    MAX_INT : DINT := 32767; // Maximum value for INT
END_VAR

// Calculate the Fibonacci number
IF N <= 2 THEN
    O := 1; // Return 1 for N <= 2
ELSE
    WHILE CNT < N DO
        O := F1 + F2; // Calculate next Fibonacci number
        IF O > MAX_INT THEN
            O := MAX_INT; // Saturation arithmetic: limit to MAX_INT
            EXIT; // Exit the loop if the maximum value is reached
        END_IF
        F1 := F2; // Update F1 to the previous F2
        F2 := O; // Update F2 to the current Fibonacci number
        CNT := CNT + 1; // Increment the counter
    END_WHILE
END_IF

END_FUNCTION_BLOCK
